GOV-F-004-S95.title: Audit Log Event Schema and Contract Definition
GOV-F-004-S95.description: Define a strict, versioned audit event schema covering actor (GPT/Claude/system), input/output payload hashes, tool usage, timestamps, trace_id, and metadata. Enforce validation via Pydantic models and reject non-conforming events.
GOV-F-004-S95.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/application/tool_models (existing Pydantic validation patterns); RECORD sprint_plan/backlog_0_1_4_perplexity BL-0.1.4-004

GOV-F-004-S96.title: Append-Only Persistence and Immutability Enforcement
GOV-F-004-S96.description: Implement storage-layer guarantees preventing updates or deletes of audit records, including write-once insertion patterns, disabled update routes, and database-level safeguards where applicable.
GOV-F-004-S96.evidence: Code/Shared/ChatHealthyMongoUtilities.py (write patterns); Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/infrastructure/debug_logger.py (existing persistence approach); RECORD sprint_plan/backlog_0_1_4_perplexity BL-0.1.4-004

GOV-F-004-S97.title: Trace and Correlation ID Propagation Middleware
GOV-F-004-S97.description: Introduce middleware/utilities to generate and propagate a consistent trace_id across all GPT and Claude execution paths, including tool_router, domain services, and Brain runner, ensuring every audit event is linkable.
GOV-F-004-S97.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/application/tool_router.py (central orchestration); Code/Shared/brain_runner.py (execution flow); RECORD sprint_plan/backlog_0_1_4_perplexity BL-0.1.4-004
